message: We propose a 10-year full-scope service agreement covering repairs, engines and rotables, with a hybrid pricing model (50% fixed, 50% tied to actual running hours). Year-1 fee of $8.0M, escalating 3% per year, 96% availability guarantee with a 15% annual penalty cap, and a lease engine is not included. We are happy to discuss adjustments that work for both sides.

Your $8.0M, 10-year proposal is well outside what we can approve. We can support a full-scope deal (repairs, engines, rotables) with a lease engine, but on a 5-year term with a $2.0M year-1 fee, 2% escalation, 97.5% availability and a 20% penalty cap. Hybrid pricing. If that works for you, we can move quickly.

We appreciate the proposal, but at $2.0M per year with a lease engine and 97.5% availability, the contract would lose money for us, so we cannot accept these terms. Thank you for your time, and we are open to revisiting if your requirements change.
